ItemID: 1; Title: Bolt Dropper 1/2" Stainless Flat Finish Washer, 1-1/4" Outside Diameter - 18-8 (304) Stainless Steel, Highly Corrosion-Resistant and Rustproof - Convenient for Any Project Needs (50 Pack); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My caster purchase suggests occasional hardware needs, but I have no clear use for this washer size right now.
ItemID: 2; Title: Cubitron II 3M Depressed Center Grinding Wheel, (78468-Q), T27, 4 in x 1/4 in x 5/8 in; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current grinding project or established need for this wheel.
ItemID: 3; Title: Tesa 51608, 25m x 19mm adhesive wiring cloth tape original ISOBAND 3 pcs pack; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this for bundling wires neatly in my electronics projects.
ItemID: 4; Title: ERYONE Filament PLA 1.75 mm, Special 3D Printing PLA Filament 1.75 mm for 3D Printers and 3D Pens,+/-0.03mm 1kg (2.2lbs)/Spool, Light Wood; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My electronics tinkering does not establish a need for 3D printer filament.
ItemID: 5; Title: Honbay 20 Pcs 1.2inch Thread Green & Red Cap SPST Latching Type Push Button Switch Off-ON; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These look useful for adding manual on/off controls to projects involving relays and circuit boards.
ItemID: 6; Title: OCR 20PCS 2.54mm Breakaway PCB Board 40Pin Male and Female Header Connector for Arduino Shield; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: These closely match my breadboard and PCB prototyping interests and would help connect modules.
ItemID: 7; Title: Premium Metal Tapping Fluid - 16 FL. OZ. Threading and Cutting Oil; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not currently cutting threads or doing machining that calls for tapping fluid.
ItemID: 8; Title: AMOLEN PLA 3D Printer Filament, Triple Color Coextrusion PLA Filament 1.75mm, Silk Shiny Red Yellow Blue Filament, 3D Printing Filament 1KG/2.2lb; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no established printing need, and decorative multicolor filament does not connect closely to my recent projects.
ItemID: 9; Title: Hydrofarm APCEM2 Autopilot Desktop CO2 Monitor & Data, Data Logger, White/Blue; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My infrared thermometer was useful for temperature checks, but I have no current reason to log CO2 levels.
ItemID: 10; Title: 1/4-20 x 2 Flat Head Floorboard Thread Cutting Screws, Type F, (Star - Six Lobe Drive), Black Phosphate Finish, Countersunk, T-30 Drive (Carton: 100pcs) Alloy Steel; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These are specialized fasteners, and I have no current floorboard project requiring them.
